d: In this video, Firstpost looks at how the internet is turning Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang into the unlikely star of a Bollywood meme fest. As memes surrounding Huang and Chinese businesswoman Alice Huang go viral, Indian social media users are taking the jokes a step further. AI-generated videos are recreating iconic Bollywood scenes, casting the Nvidia boss and Alice in everything from romantic dramas to full-blown melodramas. From famous film sequences to hilarious cinematic twists, the internet is giving the AI chipmaker a Bollywood makeover. And the memes keep multiplying. Hem Kaur Saroya…
